items.text_th: ดีหมดทุกอย่างจนย้ายมาvng รู้สึกของก็ออกยากขึ้น แพงขึ้น อะไรที่จำเป็นก็เอาออก เอาสมองส่วนไหนคิด เกมจะพังเพราะความเห็นแก่ตัวจะเอาแค่เงินนี่แหละ ไม่สนใจผู้เล่น ที่เขายังเล่นเพราะเติมกันเยอะ แจ้งอะไรก็ไม่ได้ เติมเงินผ่านธ.ก็ของไม่เข้า แจ้งคืนส่งไปก็ไม่ได้รับตอบกลับ เกมหลังบ้านห่วยสุดๆ เพิ่มเติมห่วยแตกตั้งแต่ย้ายมา เน็ตดีแต่ขึ้นให้เชื่อมต่อเน็ต ออกแอปแปปเดียวหลุดเด้งกลับหน้าแรก เกมหนังหมาจริงๆ
items.text_vn: Mọi thứ đều tốt cho đến khi chuyển sang VNG. Cảm giác đồ khó ra hơn, đắt hơn, cái gì cần thiết thì lại bỏ đi. Không biết lấy phần não nào ra nghĩ nữa. Game sẽ sập vì lòng ích kỷ chỉ biết hút tiền thôi, chẳng quan tâm người chơi. Người ta còn chơi là vì đã nạp nhiều rồi. Báo gì cũng không được, nạp tiền qua ngân hàng mà đồ không vào, gửi yêu cầu hoàn tiền cũng không được phản hồi. Hệ thống hậu trường của game tệ hết mức. Thêm nữa là tệ hại từ khi chuyển sang: mạng tốt mà vẫn hiện bắt kết nối mạng, thoát app ra một chút là bị văng về màn hình đầu. Game rác thật sự.
items.theme: Không nhận vật phẩm sau thanh toán
items.summary_vn: Sau khi sang VNG: đồ đắt hơn, nạp không nhận, CSKH im lặng, hay văng.
items.text_en: Everything was fine until the move to VNG. Items feel harder to get and more expensive, and the stuff that matters got removed. No idea what part of the brain came up with this. The game will die from greed, only sucking money and not caring about players. People only keep playing because they've already topped up a lot. Reporting doesn't help: I topped up through the bank and didn't get my items, sent a refund request and got no reply. The game's backend system is as bad as it gets. On top of that it's been awful since the move: good internet but it still asks me to connect to the network, and if I leave the app for a moment it kicks me back to the start screen. Truly a trash game.
items.summary_en: Since VNG: pricier items, missing top-ups, no support replies, frequent kicks.
